# comment: Copy under the host's local worker-config per project (e.g. local/worker-config/<project>/integration_config.json) and edit paths/commands for that repo. All paths must be absolute. See workforce/integrator.py for field meaning.
# activation_mode: "in_pass" (default) activates and verifies inline. Use "handoff" only when activate_cmd restarts the daemon the integrator pass itself runs under (e.g. WorkForce activating WorkForce, wf-276): the pass then never calls activate_cmd — it writes a marker under local_root/state/integrator-activate/<task-id>.json (task_id, version, release_root, requested_at) and ends the pass with outcome activation_handoff. A scheduled job outside any pass must read that marker and perform the restart once no implementation lane is in flight; the next pass that finds the marker checks the installed version and either retries (outcome activation_pending) or clears the marker and closes.
notes: Dry run first: python -m workforce integrate --config <this file> --dry-run
Schedulable via cron or the daemon's job scheduling; also runnable manually.
